description: Welcome to my apartment! My recently renovated and bright 3 bedroom / 1.5 bathrooms flat, located at the heart of Paris city center, perfect for those traveling with children or friends. The neighborhood is safe and family-friendly with plenty to do on your doorstep. The apartment is located in the 3rd district, the heart of the French capital!Spacious and central, this apartment will be the ideal holiday spot for your family holidays in Paris.The spaceWelcome to this 97m2 spacious and bright flat next to the emblematic centre of Paris, an ideal spot for art and culture lovers, containing some of the most emblematic monuments and museums of the city.It features a bright and comfy living area with its own dinning table and opened to a well-equipped kitchen. With airy, sunlit interiors, our local designer has created a contemporary yet classic space. Eclectic wall art and flooring give this apartment character. A fully equipped kitchen is perfect for in-house dining, and the cozy entertainment area invites you to relax with a film or a glass of wine by the garden. The apartment has a capacity for up to 9 people distributed in 3 bedrooms:- Bedroom 1: 1 Double bed- Bedroom 2: 1 Double bed - Bedroom 3: 1 Double bed + individual bed - Living room: double sofa bed Some special features! - The apartment is accessed via a very nice and quiet interior garden- No steps to reach the apartment! Wheelchair accessible and wide clearance to bedrooms and bathrooms - All bedrooms and living room area are exterior with plenty of natural light, also very quiet, perfect for a good night sleep! - Spacious living room with an open layout to a well equipped kitchen- Laptop friendly workspace by the living room, plenty of natural light, ideal for working remotely! - Portable AC machine and elec
